questions.question: Who is set to become Odisha’s first woman Chief Secretary, assuming office on January 1, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Anu Garg.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Odisha IAS officer Anu Garg is set to assume charge as the state’s first woman Chief Secretary from January 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Anu Garg, a 1991-batch IAS officer of the Odisha cadre, will succeed Manoj Ahuja as Chief Secretary after his retirement on December 31, 2025.**
 
• **She will make history as the first woman to hold the Chief Secretary post in Odisha.**
 
• **In February 2023, Anu Garg became the first woman IAS officer to serve as Development Commissioner of Odisha.**
 
• **Her appointment signifies recognition of her administrative experience and contributions to governance in Odisha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Chief Secretary__

 __
 
• The Chief Secretary is the senior-most civil servant in a state and serves as the administrative head of the state government.
 
• Responsible for coordinating the functioning of state departments and advising the state government on policy matters.
 
• The Chief Secretary also acts as a key liaison between the state and the central government.
 
 
 
• IAS Cadre__
 __
 
• The Indian Administrative Service (IAS) is the premier civil service of India responsible for administration, policy formulation, and governance.
 
• Officers are assigned to specific state cadres but can also serve in central government positions.
 
 
 
• Development Commissioner__
 __
 
• The Development Commissioner oversees state-level development programs and initiatives, focusing on economic and social development.
 
• Anu Garg’s prior role as Development Commissioner highlights her experience in state administration.
 
 
 
• Gender Milestone__
 
 
• Anu Garg’s appointment as the first woman Chief Secretary in Odisha is a historic milestone in promoting gender representation in top administrative positions.

questions.question: Following the resignation of Pieter Elbers in March 2026, who has taken over as the interim CEO of IndiGo?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Bhatia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers resigned with immediate effect on March 10, 2026, and Founder Rahul Bhatia has assumed the role of interim CEO.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leadership Change:** Rahul Bhatia, the **Managing Director and Founder** of InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo), took over the top executive role to stabilize the airline.
 
• **Reason for Resignation:** Pieter Elbers stepped down following a major **operational collapse in December 2025**, which saw over 5,000 flight cancellations.
 
• **Crisis Factor:** The disruption was largely attributed to **crew shortages** linked to the implementation of new **Flight Duty Time Limitations (FDTL)** rules.
 
• **Regulatory Impact:** The incident led to significant scrutiny from the **Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)** regarding the airline's operational management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation Ltd)__

 __
 
• Founded in - 2006
 
• Headquarters - Gurgaon, Haryana
 
• It is India's largest passenger airline by market share.
 
 
 
• Flight Duty Time Limitations (FDTL)__
 __
 
• Regulations set by the DGCA to ensure pilots and cabin crew get adequate rest to prevent fatigue-related safety risks.
 
 
 
• DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation)__
 
 
• The statutory body of the Government of India to regulate civil aviation in India. It primarily deals with safety issues.

questions.question: Who has been elected Chair of the Badminton World Federation (BWF) Athletes Commission for the 2026–2029 term?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Indian badminton icon PV Sindhu has been elected Chair of the BWF Athletes Commission for the 2026–2029 term.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PV Sindhu will serve as Chair of the BWF Athletes Commission for the 2026–2029 term and will also be a member of the BWF Council.**
 
• **She has been associated with the BWF Athletes Commission since 2017, representing athletes’ interests at the global level.**
 
• **Greysia Polii served as the Chair of the Athletes Commission in the previous term.**
 
• **Sindhu is also set to lead India at the 2026 Badminton Asia Team Championships to be held in Qingdao, China.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• PV Sindhu__

 __
 
• Two-time Olympic medallist and former world champion in badminton.

• One of India’s most successful and globally recognised badminton players.
 
 
 
• BWF Athletes Commission__
 __
 
• A body under the Badminton World Federation that represents the voice of players in decision-making.
 
• It advises the BWF Council on matters affecting athletes worldwide.
 
• The Chair of the Commission automatically serves on the BWF Council.
 
 
 
• Badminton World Federation (BWF)__
 __
 
• The global governing body for the sport of badminton.
 
• Responsible for regulating international competitions, rankings, and governance structures.
 
 
 
• Badminton Asia Team Championships 2026__
 
 
• A continental team event organised by Badminton Asia.
 
• The 2026 edition will be held in Qingdao, China, where PV Sindhu is set to lead the Indian team.

questions.question: Who was appointed National Working President of BJP from Bihar in Dec 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitin Nabin**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 

• **Nitin Nabin**, a prominent Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader from Bihar, was appointed as the **National Working President of BJP** in December 2025. 

• This appointment marked a significant move by the BJP to strengthen its political strategy and leadership presence in Bihar, a key state in Indian politics. 

• Nitin Nabin has been a well-known face in Bihar politics, serving as a **Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from Bankipur constituency** for multiple terms. 

• His appointment reflects BJP's focus on promoting leaders with strong grassroots connections and significant influence in their respective regions. 

• Nabin's leadership style, ability to connect with the masses, and experience in state politics were key factors in his selection as the National Working President. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 

• **About Nitin Nabin:** 
 

• Born in Bihar, Nitin Nabin has been a prominent leader of the BJP and is known for his work in the Bankipur constituency. 

• He has served as an MLA since **2005**, consistently winning elections due to his popularity and developmental work in the region. 

• Nabin is regarded as an advocate for youth participation in politics and has initiated several programs aimed at empowering the youth. 
 
 

• **BJP's Strategy in Bihar:** 
 

• Bihar is a politically significant state in India, contributing **40 Lok Sabha seats**. 

• The BJP has been focusing on strengthening its base in Bihar through strategic appointments and alliances to maintain its influence in state and national politics. 

• By appointing a young and dynamic leader like Nitin Nabin, the BJP aims to consolidate its position and appeal to a broader demographic. 
 
 

• **National Working President Role:** 
 

• The National Working President of BJP is responsible for **managing the party's affairs** across India, ensuring effective coordination among state units. 

• This role is crucial for implementing the party's political strategies, election campaigns, and outreach programs. 

• The position often involves direct interaction with party workers and voters, making it a key leadership role within the organization. 
 
 

• **BJP Leadership in Bihar:** 
 

• The BJP has had prominent leaders from Bihar, such as **Sushil Kumar Modi**, who served as Deputy Chief Minister for many years. 

• In recent years, the party has focused on promoting young leaders to adapt to changing political dynamics and voter expectations. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 

• **Sanjay Jaiswal:** 
 

• He is a senior BJP leader from Bihar and has served as the **state president of BJP in Bihar**. 

• While he has been instrumental in strengthening BJP's base in Bihar, he was not chosen as the National Working President in 2025. 
 
 

• **Nityanand Rai:** 
 

• A senior leader and former president of Bihar BJP, Rai has also served as a **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs.** 

• Despite his significant contributions to the party, the position was assigned to Nitin Nabin. 
 
 

• **Sushil Kumar Modi:** 
 

• A veteran BJP leader and former Deputy Chief Minister of Bihar, Sushil Kumar Modi has played a major role in the state’s politics. 

• However, the BJP chose to elevate a younger leader, Nitin Nabin, for the National Working President role in 2025.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the first-ever woman Municipal Commissioner of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwini Bhide.**__

__
 
• **Ashwini Bhide is a 1995-batch IAS officer who will succeed Bhushan Gagrani.**

questions.question: Who is the Chairman of 15th Finance Commission ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**N.K. Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **N.K. Singh** is the chairman of the 15th Finance Commission of India, which was constituted by the Government of India in **November 2017**.
 
• The 15th Finance Commission was tasked with recommending a formula for the distribution of tax revenue between the Union and States for the period **2020–2025**.
 
• N.K. Singh is a seasoned bureaucrat, economist, and politician who has held several prominent positions, including **Member of Parliament** and Secretary to the Prime Minister.
 
• The 15th Finance Commission submitted its final report in **November 2020**, focusing on fiscal federalism, addressing debt sustainability, and balancing equity among states.
 
• Under the leadership of N.K. Singh, the commission also introduced **performance-based criteria** for resource distribution, emphasizing health, education, and agricultural reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **K.C. Neogy**

 
 
• K.C. Neogy was a member of the **First Finance Commission** of India, established in **1951**.
 
• The First Finance Commission was headed by **K.C. Neogy** and played a pivotal role in setting the foundation for fiscal federalism in independent India.
 
• It recommended the distribution of financial resources between the center and states for the initial years post-independence.
 
 
 
• **Dr. C. Rangarajan**
 
 
• Dr. C. Rangarajan is a renowned economist and former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.
 
• He served as the chairman of the **12th Finance Commission** of India, which made recommendations for the period **2005–2010**.
 
• His tenure focused on fiscal consolidation and improving the financial health of states.
 
 
 
• **Y.V. Reddy**
 
 
• Y.V. Reddy, a former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, chaired the **14th Finance Commission** of India.
 
• The 14th Finance Commission recommended the distribution of financial resources for the period **2015–2020**.
 
• Under his leadership, the commission increased the share of states in the divisible pool of central taxes to **42%**, emphasizing greater fiscal autonomy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Finance Commission **

 
 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body established under Article **280** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Each Finance Commission is constituted every **five years**, and its recommendations are critical to ensuring cooperative federalism.

questions.question: As of 31st May 2025, who is the Chairman of the Bar Council of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Manan Kumar Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Manan Kumar Mishra is a senior advocate and has served as the Chairman of the **Bar Council of India (BCI)** multiple times, including his tenure as of 31st May 2025.
 
• He has played a pivotal role in framing and implementing reforms in the legal education system in India.
 
• The Bar Council of India, under his leadership, has taken strong measures to regulate and ensure the quality of legal education and the ethical standards of legal practitioners.
 
• Manan Kumar Mishra has been actively involved in resolving issues related to the legal profession, such as advocating for better welfare measures for lawyers.
 
• He has also been vocal about strengthening the independence of the judiciary and the legal profession in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashok Arora**
 
 
• Ashok Arora is a senior advocate and former Secretary of the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA).
 
• He is known for his legal acumen and contributions to discussions on judicial reforms in India.
 
• However, he has not held the position of Chairman of the Bar Council of India.
 
 
 
• **Vikas Singh**
 
 
• Vikas Singh is a prominent senior advocate and has served as the President of the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA).
 
• He is well-known for his leadership in addressing issues faced by members of the legal profession.
 
• He has not served as the Chairman of the Bar Council of India.
 
 
 
• **Dushyant Dave**
 
 
• Dushyant Dave is a senior advocate and a former President of the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA).
 
• He is recognized for his expertise in constitutional and commercial law and his strong stance on judicial independence.
 
• He has not held the position of Chairman of the Bar Council of India.
 
 
 
• **The Bar Council of India (BCI)**
 
 
• The Bar Council of India is a statutory body established under the Advocates Act, 1961.
 
• It regulates legal education and the profession of law in India.
 
• The BCI prescribes standards for legal education, organizes All India Bar Examinations (AIBE), and ensures ethical conduct among lawyers.
 
• The Chairman of the BCI is elected from among its members, who are representatives of State Bar Councils.

questions.question: Who has been elected as the first woman president of the Press Club of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty has been elected as the first woman president of the Press Club of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Her team achieved a sweeping 21-0 victory, winning all office-bearer and managing committee positions.**
 
• **Afzal Imam was elected as the Secretary General, and Jatin Gandhi became the Vice-President.**
 
• **Aditi Rajput (Treasurer) and P R Sunil (Joint Secretary) were elected unopposed.**
 
• **The managing committee includes several key members such as Niraj Kumar, Abhishek Kumar Singh, and others.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Press Club of India__

 __

• Provides a platform for media professionals to interact, discuss, and promote press freedom.
 
 
 
• Election Results__
 __
 
• Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty’s victory marks a significant milestone for women in journalism leadership.
 
• Her team’s victory shows strong support for their vision of reforming the Press Club of India.
